// Elite size, HP and spawn chance are configured in game-config.js.





/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = template.miniBoss === true || type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
  const megaType = type === 'megaMob' || (type === 'mob' && elite) ? 'megaMob' :
    type === 'megaSweeper' || (['whiteSweeper','heavySweeper'].includes(type) && elite) ? 'megaSweeper' : null;
  const dedicatedMega = Boolean(megaType);
  const profile = enemyTypeStats[megaType || type];
  const scaled = profile ? enemyStatsScalingFormula(profile, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds)) : null;
  const maxHp = (scaled?.hp ?? baseHp) * (elite && !dedicatedMega ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    miniBoss: template.miniBoss === true || (elite && type !== 'midori'),
    label: dedicatedMega ? (megaType === 'megaSweeper' ? 'Mega Sweeper' : 'Mega Mob') : elite && type !== 'midori' ? `Mega ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' && !template.miniBoss ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite && !dedicatedMega ? 2 : 1,
    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
  };
}

/** Pick from the configured standard enemy pool while keeping Mob most common. */
export function chooseStandardEnemy(random = Math.random, elapsedSeconds = 0, stageId = null) {
  const weights = stageId && enemyStagePools[stageId] ? Object.fromEntries(enemyStagePools[stageId].map(type=>[type,1])) : standardEnemyWeights;
  const entries = Object.entries(weights).filter(([type, weight]) => {
    const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
    return weight > 0 && (!profile || (elapsedSeconds >= profile.spawnStartSeconds && elapsedSeconds < profile.spawnEndSeconds));
    mirroredDirections: ['right', 'downRight'],
    layout: spriteLayouts.mob,
    x: 590, y: 260, direction: 'down', elapsed: 0, moving: false
  }
};

/** Mega Mob shares Mob's animation and body geometry, enlarged for mini-boss visibility. */
export function createMegaMob(template) {
  return {...template,label:'Mega Mob',miniBoss:true,boss:false,standard:false,special:true,
    spriteSize:(template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)*eliteSizeMultiplier,
    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob};
}

/** Retry blocked/full-population placements; consume the one-shot only on success. */
export function createMiniBossSchedule() {
  const spawned = new Set();
  return { update(seconds, spawn) {
    for (const [type, profile] of Object.entries(enemyTypeStats)) {
      if (!['megaMob','megaSweeper'].includes(type) || profile.spawnAtSeconds == null || seconds < profile.spawnAtSeconds || spawned.has(type)) continue;
      if (spawn(type)) spawned.add(type);
    }
  }};
}


/** Mega Sweeper uses the existing Sweeper art/animation at the former elite scale. */
export function createMegaSweeper(template) {
  return {...createMegaMob(template),label:'Mega Sweeper'};
}

import { timedEnemyEvents, playerSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Compact square-grid cluster; offsets are deterministic and centered on its anchor. */
export function clusterSpawnPoints(anchor, count, spacing) {
  const columns=Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(count)), rows=Math.ceil(count/columns);
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>({
    x:anchor.x+(i%columns-(columns-1)/2)*spacing,
    y:anchor.y+(Math.floor(i/columns)-(rows-1)/2)*spacing
  }));
}

/** Place each scheduled formation once; retry invalid anchors/full capacity without duplicates. */
export function createTimedEnemyEvents(getPoints, spawn, events = timedEnemyEvents, warn = () => {}) {
  const pending = new Map();
  return { update(seconds) {
    for (const event of events) {
      if (seconds<event.timeSeconds-(event.warningSeconds || 0)) continue;
      let state=pending.get(event.id);
      if (!state) { state={index:0,points:null};pending.set(event.id,state); }
      if (event.lifetimeSeconds != null && seconds >= event.timeSeconds+event.lifetimeSeconds) {
        state.index=event.count; continue;
      }
      if (state.index>=event.count) continue;
      state.points ??= getPoints(event);
      if (!state.points) continue;
      if (seconds<event.timeSeconds) {
        if (!state.warned) { warn(event,state.points);state.warned=true; }
        continue;
      }
      while (state.index<event.count) {
        if (!spawn(event,state.points[state.index])) break;
        state.index++;
      }
    }
  }};
}


/** Lock a horde's course at spawn; it never homes toward later player positions. */
export function hordeMotion(enemy) {
  const angle = enemy.chargeAngle ?? 0;
  const directions=['right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft','up','upRight'];
  return {direction:directions[(Math.round(angle/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8],
    target:{x:enemy.x+Math.cos(angle)*10000,y:enemy.y+Math.sin(angle)*10000}};
}


/** Two opposite straight walls; split odd counts without losing enemies. */
export function wallSpawnPoints(bounds, count, vertical = true) {
  const first=Math.ceil(count/2), second=count-first;
  return [first,second].flatMap((amount,side)=>Array.from({length:amount},(_,i)=>{
    const t=amount>1?i/(amount-1):.5;
    return vertical?{x:side?bounds.right:bounds.left,y:bounds.top+t*(bounds.bottom-bounds.top)}:
      {x:bounds.left+t*(bounds.right-bounds.left),y:side?bounds.bottom:bounds.top};
  }));
}

/** Only numeric overrides replace the enemy defaults; unspecified stats remain intact. */
export function timedEventStatOverrides(event, base = {}) {
  const stats=event?.stats;
  if (!stats || typeof stats!=='object') return {};
  return {...(Number.isFinite(stats.hp)?{hp:stats.hp,maxHp:stats.hp}:{}),
    ...(Number.isFinite(stats.atk)?{contactDamage:stats.atk}:
      Number.isFinite(stats.atkMultiplier)?{contactDamage:base.contactDamage*stats.atkMultiplier}:{}),
    ...(Number.isFinite(stats.spd)?{movementSpeedMultiplier:stats.spd*playerSettings.speed/playerSettings.movementBase}:Number.isFinite(stats.spdMultiplier)?{movementSpeedMultiplier:base.movementSpeedMultiplier*stats.spdMultiplier}:{}),
    ...(Number.isFinite(stats.exp)?{expReward:stats.exp}:{})};
}


/** Evenly spaced complete circle around the player's position at formation creation. */
export function ringSpawnPoints(center, count, radius) {
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>{
    const angle=i/count*Math.PI*2;
    return {x:center.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,y:center.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius};
  });
}


/** One straight line perpendicular to its fixed charge direction. */
export function stampedeSpawnPoints(anchor, target, count, spacing) {
  const angle=Math.atan2(target.y-anchor.y,target.x-anchor.x);
  return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>{
    const side=(i-(count-1)/2)*spacing;
    return {x:anchor.x-Math.sin(angle)*side,y:anchor.y+Math.cos(angle)*side,chargeAngle:angle};
  });
}

/** Stable per-slot random stream: frame rate, kills and unrelated RNG cannot change event choices. */
function eventRandom(seed, index) {
 let state=(Number(seed)^Math.imul(index+1,0x9e3779b9))>>>0;
 return ()=>{state+=0x6d2b79f5;let t=state;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return ((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};
}

/** Seeded event identity and bounded tuning; all regular/Mega variants cycle through the pool. */
export function generatedEvent(seed,index,internalSeconds) {
 const s=seededEventSettings,random=eventRandom(seed,index);
 const order=[...s.enemyTypes, ...(internalSeconds>=1800?['midori']:[])].sort((a,b)=>{
  const rank=name=>{let n=Number(seed)>>>0;for(const c of name)n=Math.imul(n^c.charCodeAt(0),16777619);return n>>>0;};
  return rank(a)-rank(b);
 });
 const enemy=order[index%order.length],patterns=['cluster','horde','wall','ring','stampede'];
 const pattern=patterns[Math.floor(random()*patterns.length)];
 return {id:`seeded-${index}`,enemy,pattern,count:pattern==='cluster'?s.clusterCount:s.minCount+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxCount-s.minCount+1)),
  lifetimeSeconds:s.minLifetime+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxLifetime-s.minLifetime+1)),
  radius:220+Math.floor(random()*81),warningSeconds:pattern==='stampede'?.8:0,stats:'default',generated:true,timeSeconds:internalSeconds,
  nextInterval:s.minInterval+Math.floor(random()*(s.maxInterval-s.minInterval+1))};
}

/** Defaults come from the relevant campaign row, even outside that type's regular spawn window. */
export function eventEnemyProfile(event,type,internalSeconds,stage) {

  matches.filter(row=>row.start<=internalSeconds).at(-1)||matches[0];
 const fallback=enemyTypeStats[type];
 const base=endlessProfile||profile||{hp:fallback?.baseHP||60,atk:fallback?.baseATK||1,spd:fallback?.baseSPD||.35,exp:fallback?.expValue||1,kind:'regular'};

/** Internal time starts groups; active time controls firing cadence, lifetimes and generated events. */
export function createCampaignEvents({seed=0,getPoints,spawn,onEnd=()=>{},warn=()=>{},chart=campaignEventChart}) {

/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
  const facing = character.horizontalFacingOnly ? character.facing : character.direction;
  const row = character.attack
    ? character.attacks[character.attack.name].rows[character.attack.facing]
    : !character.moving && character.idleRows?.[facing] !== undefined
    ? character.idleRows[facing]
    : character.rows[facing];
  // Attack artwork can exceed the grid cell. Custom rectangles keep the tank's
  // anchor fixed even when a muzzle flash needs a wider crop.
  const custom = character.layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
  if (custom) return custom;
  const { columnEdges, rowEdges } = character.layout;
  return {
    x: columnEdges[frame],
    y: rowEdges[frame][row],
    width: columnEdges[frame + 1] - columnEdges[frame],
    height: rowEdges[frame][row + 1] - rowEdges[frame][row],
    footY: character.layout.footY?.[frame]?.[row] ?? rowEdges[frame][row + 1]
  };
}

/** Select a direction-specific walking cycle, or hold frame zero when idle. */
function getAnimationFrame(character) {
  if (character.attack) {
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    return Math.min(character.layout.columnEdges.length - 2,
      Math.floor(character.attack.elapsed / attack.frameDuration));
  }
  if (!character.moving) return 0;
  const frames = character.walkFrames?.[character.direction] ||
    character.frameSequence || [1, 2, 3, 4];
  const duration = character.frameDuration || frameDuration;
  return frames[Math.floor(character.elapsed / duration) % frames.length];
}

/** Blend from the last visible pose without moving the character's world anchor. */
function beginPoseTransition(character) {
  if (character.transitionDuration && character.lastPose) {
    character.transition = { from: character.lastPose, elapsed: 0 };
  }
}

/** Render one pose with shared scale and measured foot anchors, including effects. */
function drawPose(character, pose, opacity) {
  opacity *= character.death?.opacity ?? 1;
  const crop = pose.crop;
  const displaySize = character.spriteSize || spriteSize;
  const scale = (displaySize - spritePadding * 2) / (character.referenceSize || 215);
  const width = crop.width * scale;
  const height = crop.height * scale;
  const drawY = displaySize / 2 - spritePadding - (crop.footY - crop.y) * scale;
  const drawX = crop.anchorX === undefined ? -width / 2 : -(crop.anchorX - crop.x) * scale;
  context.save();
  context.globalAlpha = opacity;
  context.translate(character.x - camera.x, character.y - camera.y);
  if (pose.mirrored) context.scale(-1, 1);
  context.drawImage(character.image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
    drawX, drawY, width, height);
  const flash = character.death
    ? 0.95 * Math.min(1, character.death.elapsed / 0.035)
    : getDamageFlashOpacity(character);
  if (flash > 0) {
    context.globalAlpha = opacity * flash;
    context.drawImage(getWhiteSprite(character.image), crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
      drawX, drawY, width, height);
    context.globalAlpha = opacity;
  }
  if (showSpriteBounds) {
    context.strokeStyle = '#e54b93';
    context.strokeRect(drawX, drawY, width, height);
    const body = getCombatHitbox(character, character !== characters[selected]);
    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
    context.beginPath();
    context.ellipse(body.x - character.x, body.y - character.y, body.rx, body.ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

/** Put tall map objects in front of actors walking behind their solid bases. */
function drawCharacterOcclusion(character) {
  if (enemyRenderLayer(character) !== 'normal') return; // Specials and bosses appear above map foregrounds.
  const opacity = character === characters[selected] ? obstacleVisibility.playerOpacity : 1;
  if (currentMap === 'first') drawOfficeMonumentOcclusion(context, character, maps.first, camera, canvas.height, opacity);
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') drawTowerOcclusion(context, character, maps.fourth, camera, opacity);
  if (currentMap === 'second') drawPalaceOcclusion(context, character, maps.second, camera, canvas.width, opacity);
}

/** Draw animation poses with a short blend when entering/leaving boss actions. */
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { combatHitboxes } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createSweeper } from './sweeper-sprites.js';

// All newly supplied sheets are992x1586, five columns/eight clockwise direction rows.
const columns=[0,198,397,595,794,992];
const rows=Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>Math.round(i*1586/8));

/** Independent templates: per-sheet crop edges remain editable for animation testing. */
export function createStandardEnemy(label, file) {
  return {label,source:`../sprites/enemies/normal/${file}`,standard:true,contactDamage:1,
    spriteSize:normalSpriteSize,referenceSize:215,frameSequence:[0,1,2,3,4],
    rows:{down:0,downLeft:1,left:2,upLeft:3,up:4,upRight:5,right:6,downRight:7},
    layout:{columnEdges:[...columns],rowEdges:Array.from({length:5},()=>[...rows])},
    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob,
    x:590,y:260,direction:'down',elapsed:0,moving:false};
}

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { combatHitboxes } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createSweeper } from './sweeper-sprites.js';

// All newly supplied sheets are992x1586, five columns/eight clockwise direction rows.
const columns=[0,198,397,595,794,992];
const rows=Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>Math.round(i*1586/8));

/** Independent templates: per-sheet crop edges remain editable for animation testing. */
export function createStandardEnemy(label, file) {
  return {label,source:`../sprites/enemies/normal/${file}`,standard:true,contactDamage:1,
    spriteSize:normalSpriteSize,referenceSize:215,frameSequence:[0,1,2,3,4],
    rows:{down:0,downLeft:1,left:2,upLeft:3,up:4,upRight:5,right:6,downRight:7},
    layout:{columnEdges:[...columns],rowEdges:Array.from({length:5},()=>[...rows])},
    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob,
    x:590,y:260,direction:'down',elapsed:0,moving:false};
}

/** New stage variants only; existing Mob/Sweeper identities keep their tuned stats/layouts. */
export function createAdditionalEnemyRoster() {
  return {
    mob2:createStandardEnemy('Mob 2','mob-2.png'),
    mob3:createStandardEnemy('Mob 3','mob-3.png'),
    opsSweeper:createSweeper('OPS Sweeper','../sprites/enemies/normal/OPS Sweeper.png'),
    arius1:createStandardEnemy('Arius 1','Arius1.png'),
    arius2:createStandardEnemy('Arius 2','Arius2.png'),
    arius3:createStandardEnemy('Arius 3','Arius3.png'),
    highlander1:createStandardEnemy('Highlander 1','Highlander1.png'),
    highlander2:createStandardEnemy('Highlander 2','Highlander2.png'),
    highlander3:createStandardEnemy('Highlander 3','Highlander3.png')
  };
}


/** Visual hop only: collision and world positions stay grounded while Pedrozilla skips. */
export function enemyBounceOffset(character) {
  const bounce=character.movementBounce;
  if (!bounce || !character.moving || character.death) return 0;
  const seconds=character.eventMotionAge ?? (character.elapsed || 0)/1000;
  const phase=(seconds % bounce.periodSeconds)/bounce.periodSeconds;
  return -bounce.height*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase)**2;
}

import { arisWeaponSettings, attackTimeFormula, supernovaSkillSettings, arisBeamVisualSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { statMultiplier, ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Create Supernova with independent automatic and EX attacks. */
export function createArisWeapon() {
  return { id: 'aris-laser', name: 'Supernova', icon: '../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png',
    level: 1, iconRotation: 45, exSkill: true };
}

/** Find the equipped laser, independently of every other automatic weapon. */
export function getArisWeapon(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'aris-laser');
}

/** Size bonuses add to base width; level7 adds a rear beam to each volley. */
export function arisLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, getArisWeapon(player)?.level || 1));
  return { level, size: 1 + (level >= 2 ? .3 : 0) + (level >= 6 ? .5 : 0),
    damage: level >= 4 ? 1.5 : 1,
    interval: arisWeaponSettings.attackInterval - (level >= 3 ? .5 : 0) - (level >= 5 ? .5 : 0),
    beams: level >= 7 ? 2 : 1 };
}

/** Roll the supplied27-33base damage range, then weapon levels and player ATK/crit. */
export function rollArisDamage(player, random = Math.random, target, damageMod = 1) {
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  return rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'aris-laser', s.damageMultiplier,
    [(arisLevelStats(player).damage - 1) * 100],
    { projectileCount: arisLevelStats(player).beams, hitCooldownFrames: s.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, { target, damageMod });
}

/** Invisible piercing capsule starts at the player, bridging the decorative muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamHits(enemy, origin, angle, width, length = arisWeaponSettings.beamLength) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + width / 2, ry: body.ry + width / 2 },
    origin.x, origin.y, origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * length, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * length);
}

/** Pure presentation timing; only the active3seconds authorize EX damage. */
export function supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed) {
  const openingDuration = arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds + arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds;
  const beamAge = elapsed-openingDuration;
  return { openingDuration, beamAge,
    damaging: beamAge >= 0 && beamAge < supernovaSkillSettings.duration,
    beamFinished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier,
    finished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier +
      arisBeamVisualSettings.weaponReturnSeconds };
}


/** Fade and slide out from the player's center, hold through firing/tail, then return. */
export function supernovaWeaponPose(elapsed, player = {label:'Plana',x:0,y:0}, angle = 0) {
  const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
  const phase = supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed);
  const smooth = value => { const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)); return t*t*(3-2*t); };
  const emerge = smooth(elapsed/visual.openingSeconds);
  const returnStart = phase.openingDuration + supernovaSkillSettings.duration*visual.durationMultiplier;
  const returning = smooth((elapsed-returnStart)/visual.weaponReturnSeconds);
  const progress = emerge*(1-returning);
  return {opacity:progress, offset:(arisBeamOffset(arisBeamAnchor(player),angle)-visual.weaponLength/2)*progress,
    length:visual.weaponLength};
}


/** Use the real player collider center, including its vertical sprite offset. */
export function arisBeamAnchor(player) { return getCombatHitbox(player, false); }

/** Start10px beyond the hitbox boundary along the aimed ray; works for ellipses too. */
export function arisBeamOffset(anchor, angle) {
  const rx = Math.max(anchor.rx || 0, 0.000001), ry = Math.max(anchor.ry || 0, 0.000001);
  return 1/Math.hypot(Math.cos(angle)/rx,Math.sin(angle)/ry) + supernovaSkillSettings.hitboxGap;
}

/** Mega Mob shares Mob's animation and body geometry, enlarged for mini-boss visibility. */
export function createMegaMob(template) {
  return {...template,label:'Mega Mob',miniBoss:true,boss:false,standard:false,special:true,
    spriteSize:(template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)*(template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier),
    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob};
}

import { spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';
/** Show stationary, AI-free copies of every mob in eight direction columns. */
export function openAnimationLineup(characters) {
  document.querySelector('#animation-lineup')?.close();
  document.querySelector('#animation-lineup')?.remove();
  const directions=['down','downLeft','left','upLeft','up','upRight','right','downRight'];
  const dialog=document.createElement('dialog');
  dialog.id='animation-lineup';
  const header=document.createElement('header');
  const title=document.createElement('h2');title.textContent='Mob animation lineup — AI off';
  const close=document.createElement('button');close.type='button';close.textContent='Close';
  close.addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.close());header.append(title,close);dialog.append(header);
  const scroll=document.createElement('div');scroll.className='animation-lineup-scroll';dialog.append(scroll);
  const previews=[];
  for(const [id,template] of Object.entries(characters)) {
    if(!(template.standard || id==='mob' || template.miniBoss) || !template.layout || template.boss)continue;
    const row=document.createElement('section');row.className='animation-lineup-row';
    const label=document.createElement('h3');label.textContent=template.label||id;row.append(label);
    for(const direction of directions) {
      const cell=document.createElement('figure'),canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
      // Enough room for native-sized Mega sprites and the skipping animation.
      canvas.width=220;canvas.height=240;
      const caption=document.createElement('figcaption');caption.textContent=direction;
      cell.append(canvas,caption);row.append(cell);
      previews.push({canvas,template,direction,index:previews.length});
    }
    scroll.append(row);
  }
  document.body.append(dialog);dialog.showModal();
  let request;
  const started=performance.now();
  /** Animate sheet frames in place, honoring custom crop rectangles and foot anchors. */
  function draw(now) {
    const elapsed=now-started;
    for(const {canvas,template,direction,index} of previews) {
      const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      if(!template.image)continue;
      const sequence=template.walkFrames?.[direction]||template.frameSequence||[1,2,3,4];
      const frame=sequence[Math.floor(elapsed/(template.frameDuration||110))%sequence.length];
      const row=template.rows[direction];
      if(row===undefined)continue;
      const layout=template.layout,x=layout.columnEdges[frame],y=layout.rowEdges[frame][row];
      const crop=layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame]||{x,y,width:layout.columnEdges[frame+1]-x,
        height:layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]-y,footY:layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]};
      const scale=Math.min((template.spriteSize-spriteDisplayPadding*2)/(template.referenceSize||215),200/crop.width,205/crop.height);
      const mirrored=template.mirroredDirections?.includes(direction);
      const bounce=template.movementBounce;
      const hop=bounce?-bounce.height*Math.sin(Math.PI*(elapsed/1000/bounce.periodSeconds+index*.61803398875))**2:0;
      context.save();context.translate(110,185+hop);if(mirrored)context.scale(-1,1);
      context.drawImage(template.image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,
        crop.anchorX===undefined?-crop.width*scale/2:-(crop.anchorX-crop.x)*scale,
        -(crop.footY-crop.y)*scale,crop.width*scale,crop.height*scale);
      context.restore();
    }
    request=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    facing: 'right', nativeFacing: 'right', contactRecoveryDelay: false,
    x: 310, y: 260, direction: 'right', elapsed: 0, moving: false
  },

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { combatHitboxes } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createSweeper } from './sweeper-sprites.js';

// Five columns/eight direction rows. Individual sheets can override measured dimensions.
const columns=[0,198,397,595,794,992];

/** Independent templates: per-sheet crop edges remain editable for animation testing. */
export function createStandardEnemy(label, file, {height=1586, revision=''} = {}) {
  // Arius uses a 1585px sheet; round each cell boundary against its actual height.
  const sheetRows=Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>Math.round(i*height/8));
  return {label,source:`../sprites/enemies/normal/${file}${revision?`?v=${revision}`:''}`,standard:true,contactDamage:1,
    spriteSize:normalSpriteSize,referenceSize:215,frameSequence:[0,1,2,3,4],
    rows:{down:0,downLeft:1,left:2,upLeft:3,up:4,upRight:5,right:6,downRight:7},
    layout:{columnEdges:[...columns],rowEdges:Array.from({length:5},()=>[...sheetRows])},
    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob,
    x:590,y:260,direction:'down',elapsed:0,moving:false};
}

/** New stage variants only; existing Mob/Sweeper identities keep their tuned stats/layouts. */
export function createAdditionalEnemyRoster() {
  return {
    mob2:createStandardEnemy('Mob 2','mob-2.png',{revision:'20261103'}),
    mob3:createStandardEnemy('Mob 3','mob-3.png',{revision:'20261103'}),
    opsSweeper:createSweeper('OPS Sweeper','../sprites/enemies/normal/OPS Sweeper.png'),
    arius1:createStandardEnemy('Arius 1','Arius1.png',{height:1585,revision:'20261103'}),
    arius2:createStandardEnemy('Arius 2','Arius2.png',{height:1585,revision:'20261103'}),
    arius3:createStandardEnemy('Arius 3','Arius3.png',{height:1585,revision:'20261103'}),
    highlander1:createStandardEnemy('Highlander 1','Highlander1.png',{revision:'20261103'}),
    highlander2:createStandardEnemy('Highlander 2','Highlander2.png',{revision:'20261103'}),
    highlander3:createStandardEnemy('Highlander 3','Highlander3.png',{revision:'20261103'})
  };
}

  return {
    label, source, standard: true, contactDamage: 1,
    spriteSize: normalSpriteSize * sweeperSettings.sizeRatio,
    referenceSize: 160,
    rows: { down: 0, downLeft: 1, left: 2, upLeft: 3, up: 4, upRight: 5, right: 6, downRight: 7 },
    frameSequence: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],
    layout: { columnEdges: [0, 198, 397, 595, 794, 992],
      rowEdges: Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => [...rowEdges]) },
    combatHitbox: combatHitboxes.mob, // Share Mob circle/center adjustments instead of duplicating them.
    x: 590, y: 260, direction: 'down', elapsed: 0, moving: false
  };
}
  const bounce=character.movementBounce;
  if (!bounce || !character.moving || character.death) return 0;
  const seconds=character.eventMotionAge ?? (character.elapsed || 0)/1000;
  const period=bounce.periodSeconds*(character.bouncePeriodScale ?? 1);
  const phase=((seconds/period+(character.bouncePhase ?? 0))%1+1)%1;
  return -bounce.height*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase)**2;
}


/** Pedrozilla's staggered artwork needs per-frame bottom crops to exclude the next row. */
export function pedrozillaLayout(baseLayout) {
  // Measured main-sprite bottoms in source pixels, indexed by direction row then frame.
  const bottoms=[[194, 194, 186, 194, 194], [392, 393, 378, 391, 393], [591, 591, 579, 591, 594], [783, 780, 766, 780, 783], [975, 970, 959, 971, 975], [1169, 1167, 1149, 1167, 1170], [1370, 1366, 1352, 1370, 1370], [1572, 1565, 1554, 1572, 1572]];
  const frames=Object.fromEntries(bottoms.map((ends,row)=>[row,Object.fromEntries(ends.map((bottom,frame)=>{
    const x=baseLayout.columnEdges[frame],y=baseLayout.rowEdges[frame][row];
    return [frame,{x,y,width:baseLayout.columnEdges[frame+1]-x,height:bottom-y,
      footY:baseLayout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]}];
  }))]));
  return {...baseLayout,frames};
}

export function arius2Layout(baseLayout) {

      anchorX:cellX+(left+right)/2,footY:baseLayout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]}];
  }))]));
  return {...baseLayout,frames};
}

/** Load a sheet before animation begins and report an actionable loading error. */
function loadSheet(character) {
  if (character.gifFrames) return loadGifAnimation(character);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => {
      character.image = image;
      resolve();
    };
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${character.source}.`));
    image.src = character.source;
  });
}

/** Resolve keyboard input to one of the four supported movement directions. */
function directionForKey(key) {
  return {
    ArrowUp: 'up', w: 'up', ArrowDown: 'down', s: 'down',
    ArrowLeft: 'left', a: 'left', ArrowRight: 'right', d: 'right'
  }[key.length === 1 ? key.toLowerCase() : key];
}

/** Clear held input when focus is lost so characters cannot get stuck moving. */
function releaseControls() {
  heldDirections.clear();
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
  if (isGameplayPaused()) return;
  // Let admin form fields use their own arrow keys and text input.
  if (event.target?.closest('input, select, textarea')) return;
  const direction = directionForKey(event.key);
  if (!direction) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  if (!event.repeat) heldDirections.set(event.code, direction);

/** Draw animation poses with a short blend when entering/leaving boss actions. */
function drawCharacter(character) {
  if (character.death && character.lastPose && !character.animationFrames) {
    drawPose(character, character.lastPose, 1);
    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
    return;
  }
  if (character.animationFrames) {
    const frame = character.animationFrames[gifFrameAt(character.animationFrames, character.gifElapsed || 0)];
    const image = frame.image;
    drawPose({ ...character, image }, {
      crop: { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight, footY: image.naturalHeight },
      mirrored: character.facing !== (character.nativeFacing || 'left')
    }, 1);
    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
    return;
  }

    crop: getFrameRectangle(character, getAnimationFrame(character)),

  };

  if (transition) {
    const progress = Math.min(1, transition.elapsed / character.transitionDuration);
    drawPose(character, transition.from, 1 - progress);
    drawPose(character, pose, progress);
    if (progress === 1) character.transition = null;
  } else {
    drawPose(character, pose, 1);
  }
  character.lastPose = pose;
  drawCharacterOcclusion(character);

import { enemyContactDamageFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

// Contact reaction settings live in game-config.js.
/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const enemyBody = getCombatHitbox(npc, true), playerBody = getCombatHitbox(player, false);
  const rx = enemyBody.rx + playerBody.rx, ry = enemyBody.ry + playerBody.ry;
  const fromX = playerBody.x - motion.x, fromY = playerBody.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const scaledLength = (motion.x / rx) ** 2 + (motion.y / ry) ** 2;
  const t = scaledLength ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((enemyBody.x - fromX) * motion.x / rx ** 2 +
      (enemyBody.y - fromY) * motion.y / ry ** 2) / scaledLength)) : 1;
  const dx = enemyBody.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
  const dy = enemyBody.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  const nx = distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1;
  const ny = distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0;
  const radius = 1 / Math.hypot(nx / rx, ny / ry);
  return { touching: (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2 < 1, pushing, radius, nx, ny,
    overlap: Math.max(0, radius - Math.hypot(enemyBody.x - playerBody.x, enemyBody.y - playerBody.y)) };
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move, survivalSeconds = 0) {
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  // Per-enemy attack cooldown is separate from recoil and the player's global I-frames.
  npc.playerHitCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.playerHitCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0) && !(npc.playerHitCooldown > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    const damage = npc.perTypeStats ? Math.floor(baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1)) :
      enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, player.level || 1, survivalSeconds, npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1);
    const damaged = damagePlayer(player, damage);
    if (damaged && npc.type === 'yuuka') npc.playerHitCooldown = yuukaSettings.contactHitInterval;
    if (damaged) player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = hit.overlap;
    const knockback = beginKnockback(npc, hit.nx * (settings.distance + overlap),
      hit.ny * (settings.distance + overlap), settings.travel);
    npc.contactReaction = knockback ? { ...knockback, kind, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny } : null;
    if (!knockback) npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  advanceKnockback(npc, reaction, delta, move);
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;

/** Load predecoded GIF display frames while retaining original frame durations. */
export async function loadGifAnimation(character) {
  character.animationFrames = await Promise.all(character.gifFrames.map(frame =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => resolve({ image, duration: frame.duration });
      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${frame.source}.`));
      image.src = frame.source;
    })
  ));
  character.image = character.animationFrames[0].image;
}

/** Select the original GIF frame for elapsed playback time, including while idle. */
export function gifFrameAt(frames, elapsed) {
  const total = frames.reduce((sum, frame) => sum + frame.duration, 0);
  let time = elapsed % total;
  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    time -= frames[i].duration;
    if (time < 0) return i;
  }
  return 0;
}

/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula(character.damageReductionPercent ?? []));
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - absorbed));
  const taken = absorbed + previous - character.hp;
  if (taken > 0) {
    character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    showDamageNumber(character, taken, true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

import { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

const numbers = [];
const textCache = new Map();
let font;

/** Load one shared bitmap font for all damage numbers. */
export function loadDamageNumberGraphics() {
  font = new Image();
  font.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return font.decode();
}

/** Format normal hits, yellow critical hits, or red supercrit visuals. */
export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if (hitType === 'miss') return { text: 'MISS', color: '#ffffff', italic: true };
  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
  if (player) return { text, color: '#ff5265', italic: false };
  if (hitType === 'supercritical') return { text: `${text}!!!`, color: '#ff5265', italic: true };
  if (hitType === 'critical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffe15a', italic: true };
  return { text, color: '#ffffff', italic: false };
}

/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/** Cache compact tinted bitmap numbers, preserving the font's dark outline. */
function numberGraphic(text, color) {
  const key = `${text}:${color}`;
  if (textCache.has(key)) return textCache.get(key);
  const glyphs = [...text].map(letter => fontMetrics[letter] || fontMetrics['?']);
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = glyphs.reduce((sum, glyph) => sum + glyph.width - 1, 1);
  canvas.height = 20;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let x = 0;
  for (const glyph of glyphs) {
    context.drawImage(font, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
      x, glyph.offsetY, glyph.width, glyph.height);
    x += glyph.width - 1;
  }
  if (color !== '#ffffff') {
    const mask = document.createElement('canvas');
    mask.width = canvas.width;
    mask.height = canvas.height;
    mask.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    context.fillStyle = color;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    context.drawImage(mask, 0, 0);
  }
  if (textCache.size >= 128) textCache.delete(textCache.keys().next().value);
  textCache.set(key, canvas);
  return canvas;
}

/** Draw world-anchored numbers above actors, leaving the HUD unaffected. */
export function drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, width, height) {
  if (!font?.naturalWidth) return;
  context.save();
  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  for (const number of numbers) {
    const pose = damageNumberPose(number);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (x < -100 || y < -50 || x > width + 100 || y > height + 50) continue;
    const graphic = numberGraphic(number.text, number.color);
    context.save();
    context.translate(x, y);
    if (number.italic) context.transform(1, 0, -0.18, 1, 0, 0);
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(graphic, -graphic.width * 0.625, 0, graphic.width * 1.25, 25);
    context.restore();

import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';

/** Locate Plana's equipped umbrella without selecting or switching active weapons. */
export function getUmbrella(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
}

/** Cumulative weapon-level bonuses; awakening is a separate state after level seven. */
export function umbrellaLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, getUmbrella(player)?.level || 1));
  const damageTiers = Number(level >= 2) + Number(level >= 5);
  const areaTiers = Number(level >= 3) + Number(level >= 6);
  return {
    level, damageMultiplier: (1 + umbrellaUpgradeSettings.damageIncrease) ** damageTiers,
    areaScale: Math.sqrt(1 + areaTiers * umbrellaUpgradeSettings.areaIncrease),
    intervalMultiplier: level >= 4 ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.intervalMultiplier : 1,
    guaranteedCritical: level >= 7,
    awakened: Boolean(getUmbrella(player)?.awakened)
  };
}

/** Nominal weapon damage only; all variation is applied after character ATK. */
export function umbrellaBaseDamage() {
  return umbrellaSettings.damage * umbrellaSettings.damageMultiplier;
}

/** Apply weapon upgrades first, then player ATK and the appropriate critical multiplier. */
export function rollUmbrellaDamage(player, base = umbrellaBaseDamage(), random = Math.random, damageMod = 1, target) {
  const stats = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
  return rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'plana-umbrella', base / 10,
    [ (stats.damageMultiplier - 1) * 100 ], { projectileCount: 1, hitCooldownFrames: umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, {
    damageMod, target, forceCritical: stats.guaranteedCritical,
    criticalMultiplier: stats.guaranteedCritical ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.finalCriticalMultiplier : undefined
  });
}

## My request:
you cannot awaken via upgrade. Awakening weapons is not implemented for now, only main weapon is. In game icon 2 sprite sheet, this is the icon you need to look for.

Obtaining
Crafters have a 1/1301 chance to be dropped by defeated enemies, and the rate can be increased by using Credit Card. Whenever an Crafter drops, it will be indicated by a big white arrow, the same way Item Boxes are indicated. This arrow will appear at the edge of the screen pointing to the Crafter's direction if the Crafter is out of view, allowing players to pinpoint in which direction the Anvil appears. There is a limit of 20 Crafters showing up at any given moment if the game goes on for long enough.

Upgrading
When activated by the player, an Crafter allows players to select one of their currently equipped weapons or items to upgrade, in contrast to the standard Level Up method where players have no choice but to rely on random chance. An Anvil can only perform one upgrade per use, (unless the player has Crafters Gear. Yet to be added) after which the Crafter is consumed and disappears. Players that have already activated an Crafter can also cancel out of it, which leaves the Crafter unused allowing players to return to it later.

Enhancing
Items can only be upgraded up to their maximum level, whereas weapons, including synnergies (not added yet), can be upgraded above their maximum levels by using the Enhancement system to grant them a small damage boost. 

Enhancements are applied to weapons using the Crafter's "Upgrade" option, however while upgrading items and weapons before its maximum level is free, the enhancement ranks must be bought with Credits. The enhancement costs start at 50 Credits, with each subsequent upgrade costing an additional 50 coins per level. Additionally, while there is no limit as to how high a rank a weapon can attain, each rank upgrade has a decreasing chance of success: starting at 100% success rate for the Level 1 upgrade, each subsequent upgrade level reduces the success rate by 10% until the minimum of 10%. Failing an upgrade will cause the spent Credits to be lost, and the anvil to be consumed. The success rate can be increased by purchasing the Enhancement Rate Up upgrade in the store.

Each enhancement rank increases the weapon's base damage by 2, split based on the amount of projectiles the weapon has. Generally, the split count is based on the attack count of the weapon's primary attack sequence, including extra projectiles gained from levels, "+1 Projectile" enchantment, Projectile Up [Mod] and [tobeadded] skill. Secondary attacks, like Awakened form or on-hit effects, generally do not increase the split count. Enhancement damage bonus does not benefit from other bonuses to weapon's base damage, such as level up, enchantment and [mod] bonuses, or the Growth IconGrowth shop upgrade, but scales with the player's ATK and all other damage multipliers.

Enchanting
The Enchantment system must be unlocked in the Upgrades shop before the option becomes available.

Using the Crafter, players can apply an enchantment to any weapon that is not the character's starting weapon, which will boost one of its stats chosen at random. Players can repeat the enchanting process to roll for a different random boost, replacing the previous enchantment. Each enchantment roll costs 250 Credits. Weapons may also already come pre-enchanted, which will be signified in the Level Up menu by the weapon text being blue and the random stat boost being displayed.

Generally, only one enchantment can be applied to a weapon at a time, but it is possible to obtain Synergy weapons with two enchantments at the same time by combining two already enchanted weapons in the Golden Crafter. Enchanting this kind of weapon with a double enchantment again will also replace them both with two new ones. This can also result in two identical enchantments. Otherwise, enchanting a collab weapon will only result in one enchantment as normal.

Below is a list of possible enchantments, their effects and compatible weapons. If an enchantment is available to a basic weapon, it will also typically be available to the collabs that use that weapon. Exceptions consist of projectile for non-Multishot collabs like (weapon not yet added), Cooldown for constantly on-screen synnergies like (not any weapon added yet), or Size for after-effect collabs like (weapon not yet added).

I will provide list of enchantments later when we have all weapons made.

--


Golden Crafter
Golden Crafters are a special form of the Crafters that are only used to make Synergy weapons by fusing two MAX level weapons. Golden Crafters can only appear when the player has 2 or more MAX level weapons that can be combined with each other. There can only be one Golden Crafters present at a time.

The probability for a golden anvil to appear is increased through time with the formula
```dropChance = (1 + minuteTimer/20)/100 ```

import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings, levelUpgradeSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { ensurePlayerStats } from './player-stats.js';
import { createArisWeapon, getArisWeapon } from './aris-weapon.js';
import { getUmbrella } from './weapon-progression.js';
import { getLootTotals, spendSecretTechNotes } from './exp-drops.js';

const descriptions = {
  2: 'Increase damage by 30%.',
  3: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',
  4: 'Reduce time between attacks by 10%.',
  5: 'Increase damage by 30%.',
  6: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',
  7: 'Critical hits are guaranteed and deal 3x damage.'
};

/** Offer only the next upgrade for an equipped, implemented weapon. */
function umbrellaChoices(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const weapon = getUmbrella(player);
  if (!weapon) return [];
  const level = weapon.level || 1;
  if (level < umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel) return [{ id: 'umbrella-level',
    name: `Plana's Umbrella LV ${level + 1}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon', description: descriptions[level + 1] }];
  if (!weapon.awakened && getLootTotals().secretTechNotes >= umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost) return [{
    id: 'umbrella-awaken', name: "Awaken Plana's Umbrella", weapon, category: 'Awakening',
    description: `Spend ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note to awaken this max-level weapon.`
  }];
  return [];
}

const arisDescriptions = {
  2: 'Increase beam size by 30%.',
  3: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  4: 'Increase damage by 50%.',
  5: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  6: 'Increase beam size by 50%.',
  7: 'Fire an additional beam from behind.'
};

/** Offer acquisition or the next Aris upgrade, plus existing umbrella choices. */
export function rollLevelUpgrades(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const choices = umbrellaChoices(player);
  const weapon = getArisWeapon(player);
  if (!weapon && (player.attackSlots || []).filter(Boolean).length < 6) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-new', name: "Supernova LV 1", weapon: createArisWeapon(), category: 'NEW Weapon',
    description: 'Shoot a powerful piercing laser beam every 3 seconds.'
  });
  else if (weapon && (weapon.level || 1) < arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-level', name: `Supernova LV ${(weapon.level || 1) + 1}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon',
    description: arisDescriptions[(weapon.level || 1) + 1]
  });
  else if (weapon && !weapon.awakened && getLootTotals().secretTechNotes >= arisWeaponSettings.awakeningNoteCost) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-awaken', name: "Awaken Supernova", weapon, category: 'Awakening',
    description: `Spend ${arisWeaponSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note to awaken this max-level weapon.`
  });
  return choices.slice(0, levelUpgradeSettings.choices);
}

/** Advance at most one weapon level or awaken separately; preserve the level-seven cap. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  const weapon = id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = createArisWeapon();
    else player.attackSlots.push(createArisWeapon());
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if (id === 'aris-awaken') {
    if (!spendSecretTechNotes(arisWeaponSettings.awakeningNoteCost)) return false;
    weapon.awakened = true;
  } else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-awaken') {
    if (!spendSecretTechNotes(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost)) return false;
    weapon.awakened = true;
  } else return false;
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;
}
import { eliteExpTotalFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { pickupSettings, pickupRangeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { mobExpFormula, reportSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { lootLandingRadius, pickupMagnet, creditDropChance, secretNoteDropChance, eliteLoot, dropScatter, eliteExpRewards, bossExpRewards } from './game-config.js';
export { lootLandingRadius, pickupMagnet, creditDropChance, secretNoteDropChance, eliteLoot, dropScatter, eliteExpRewards, bossExpRewards } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings } from './yuuka.js';

// World-space records survive camera scrolling and map switches for this session.
const drops = new Map();
let nextId = 0;
let getActivePlayer = () => ({ level: 1 });
let isLandingClear = () => true;
 // Clearance for rotated report/credit/note artwork.
const iconWidth = pickupSettings.iconWidth; // EDIT drop size: 25% larger; roughly 30% of Plana's visible height.
const pickupRadius = pickupSettings.walkOverRadius; // EDIT walk-over collection radius in world pixels.
 // Pixels/secÃƒâ€šÃ‚Â² and pixels/sec.
 // EDIT occasional credit chance (~1.11%).
 // 0.1% per defeated enemy.
// EDIT elite bonus rewards independently of normal-enemy drop rates.

const lootTotals = { credits: 0, secretTechNotes: 0 }; // Shared across avatar swaps.


/** Find walkable ground near the intended landing, even if an enemy died inside an obstacle. */
export function safeDropLanding(x, y) {
  if (isLandingClear(x, y, lootLandingRadius)) return { x, y };
  for (let radius = 24; radius <= 2048; radius += 24) {
    const samples = Math.min(64, Math.ceil(radius / 12) * 8);
    for (let index = 0; index < samples; index++) {
      const angle = index / samples * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * radius, py = y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      if (isLandingClear(px, py, lootLandingRadius)) return { x: px, y: py };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Redirect a scatter to safe ground; retain unplaceable loot for a later retry. */
export function constrainDropLanding(drop) {
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  const landing = safeDropLanding(flight.x + flight.dx, flight.y + flight.dy);
  drop.pendingLanding = !landing;
  if (landing) {
    flight.dx = landing.x - flight.x;
    flight.dy = landing.y - flight.y;
  }
}

/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */
export function launchDrop(drop, random = Math.random) {
  const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = dropScatter.minDistance + random() * (dropScatter.maxDistance - dropScatter.minDistance);
  drop.scatter = { elapsed: 0, x: drop.x, y: drop.y,
    dx: Math.cos(angle) * distance, dy: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
    rotation: drop.rotation, spin: (random() - 0.5) * Math.PI };
  constrainDropLanding(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Animate the outward toss before enabling pickup attraction or collection. */
export function updateDropScatter(drop, delta) {
  if (!drop.scatter) return false;
  if (drop.pendingLanding) {
    drop.landingRetry = (drop.landingRetry || 0) - delta;
    if (drop.landingRetry <= 0) { constrainDropLanding(drop); drop.landingRetry = 0.5; }
    if (drop.pendingLanding) return true;
  }
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  flight.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const t = Math.min(1, flight.elapsed / dropScatter.duration);
  const progress = 1 - (1 - t) ** 2;
  drop.x = flight.x + flight.dx * progress;
  drop.y = flight.y + flight.dy * progress;
  drop.lift = 4 * dropScatter.hopHeight * t * (1 - t);
  drop.rotation = flight.rotation + flight.spin * progress;
  if (t === 1) { delete drop.scatter; drop.lift = 0; }
  return true;
}

/** Read a snapshot of collected session inventory, including spendable awakening notes. */
export function getLootTotals() {
  return { ...lootTotals };
}

/** Spend collected notes atomically; failed awakenings never consume currency. */
export function spendSecretTechNotes(amount) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(amount) || amount <= 0 || lootTotals.secretTechNotes < amount) return false;
  lootTotals.secretTechNotes -= amount;
  return true;
}

/** Inspect all ground loot, including credits and Secret Tech Notes. */
export function getGroundLoot() {
  return [...drops.values()];
}

/** Discard uncollected loot on a map change; collected inventory remains intact. */
  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
}


/** Measure character-to-target world distance at the hit, never from projectile origin. */
export function characterHaloMultiplier(character, target) {
  if (!target || ![character.x, character.y, target.x, target.y].every(Number.isFinite)) return 1;
  return haloDamageFormula(Math.hypot(target.x - character.x, target.y - character.y), character.haloLevel ?? 0);
}

import { percentBonusFormula, attackDamageFormula, weaponDamageFormula, growthSettings, totalATKFormula, attackStatSettings, totalCritModFormula, bonusDamageTakenFormula, damageBonusFormula, damageReductionFormula, haloDamageFormula, damageModifiersFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { defaultCombatStats, combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value);
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */

  function update(player, previous, delta = 0) {
    const footOffset = (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
    const start = { x: previous.x, y: previous.y + footOffset };
    const end = { x: player.x, y: player.y + footOffset };
    const dx = end.x - start.x, dy = end.y - start.y;
    const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      // Let the toss finish so contact kills cannot instantly swallow the drops.
      if (updateDropScatter(drop, delta)) continue;
      const fraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - start.x) * dx + (drop.y - start.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const sweptDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - start.x - dx * fraction, drop.y - start.y - dy * fraction);
      if (drop.pickupTarget !== player) {
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.walkOverPickup = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        drop.pickupTarget = player;

/** Pause on pending levels, present four upgrades, and resume after all choices are spent. */
export function createLevelUpMenu({ canvas, getPlayer, isPauseMenuOpen, releaseControls, onOpen, onChoose }) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('#level-up-menu');
  const choicesElement = document.querySelector('#level-up-choices');
  const continueButton = document.querySelector('#level-up-continue');
  let player = null, choices = [], selected = 0, previousInert = [];
  const textRenderers = new WeakMap();
  const observers = new Map();

  /** Create accessible, wrapped sprite-font copy with consistent baselines. */
  function text(element, value, scale = 1.2) {
    let renderer = textRenderers.get(element);
    if (!renderer) {
      const graphic = document.createElement('canvas');
      element.replaceChildren(graphic);
      renderer = createBitmapText(graphic, { variant: 'font2', scale, outlineOverlap: 1,
        maxWidth: Math.max(100, element.clientWidth || 400), wrap: element.tagName === 'P' });
      textRenderers.set(element, renderer);

    }
    if (!observers.has(element)) {
      const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => renderer.setMaxWidth(Math.max(100, element.clientWidth)));
      observer.observe(element); observers.set(element, observer);
    }
    renderer.setText(value);
  }

  /** Highlight/focus a choice, supporting mouse and keyboard equally. */
  function select(index, focus = true) {
    if (!choices.length) { continueButton.focus({ preventScroll: true }); return; }
    selected = (index + choices.length) % choices.length;
    [...choicesElement.children].forEach((button, i) => {
      button.classList.toggle('selected', i === selected);
      button.tabIndex = i === selected ? 0 : -1;
    });
    if (focus) choicesElement.children[selected]?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  /** Apply once, then show the next queued level or return control to gameplay. */
  function choose(index) {
    if (!player || !choices[index] || !applyLevelUpgrade(player, choices[index].id)) return;
    onChoose(player);
    if (player.pendingUpgrades > 0) render();
    else close();
  }

  /** Render character stats and a fresh choice set for one earned level. */
  function render() {
    for (const observer of observers.values()) observer.disconnect();
    observers.clear();
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-title'), 'LEVEL UP!', 2);
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-help'), 'Choose an upgrade to continue. Up / Down to select, Enter to confirm.', .9);
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-name'), player.label, 1.3);
    const earnedLevel = player.level - player.pendingUpgrades + 1;
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-progress'), `Level ${earnedLevel} - Choose an upgrade`, 1.1);
    const portrait = document.querySelector('#level-up-portrait');
    const label = player.label.toLowerCase();
    const source = label.includes('plana') ? '../sprites/Plana_Portrait.png'
      : label.includes('arona') ? '../sprites/Arona_Portrait.png' : '';
    portrait.hidden = !source;
    if (source) portrait.src = source;
    const stats = document.querySelector('#level-up-stats');
    stats.replaceChildren();
    for (const [name, icon, value] of statRows) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
        canSpawnWave: () => !(campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode) && !pendingStageTransition && (!(endlessMode || endlessBuildup.active) || endlessBuildup.allowsBossWave),
        onSpawn: npcTools.refresh, isEndless: () => endlessMode,
        getBossTypes: () => Object.keys(characters).filter(type => characters[type].boss) });
      onEnemyDefeat(({ enemy }) => {
        runScore.recordDefeat(enemy);
        campaignSchedule.recordDefeat(enemy);
        if(pendingStageTransition) return;
        if(campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode) {
          if(!campaignSchedule.readyToAdvance) return;
        } else if(!bossWaveIsDefeated(enemy,getAllEnemies(),bossSpawner.hasPendingWave)) return;
        advanceStageAfterClear();
      });
      levelUpMenu = createLevelUpMenu({ canvas, getPlayer: () => characters[selected],
        isPauseMenuOpen: () => Boolean(pauseMenu?.paused), releaseControls,
        onOpen: () => skillCasting?.cancel('levelup'),
        onChoose: player => { hud.update(player); playerStatsTools.update(); }
      });
      pauseMenu = createPauseMenu({ canvas, isBlocked: () => Boolean(levelUpMenu?.active), getPlayer: () => characters[selected], releaseControls,
        onPause: () => skillCasting?.cancel('pause') });
      document.querySelector('#run-seed-status').textContent = `Run seed: ${runSeed} | Started: ${runStartedAt.toLocaleString()}`;
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    })
    .catch(error => { status.textContent = error.message; });
}

/** Build weapon damage with independent level bonuses and optional purchased Growth.
 * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.
 */
export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, bonusesPercent, {
    ...options, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank, playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}


/** Add the accumulated item/skill ATK bonus to the character's independent base ATK. */
export function totalCharacterATK(character) {
  return totalATKFormula(character.baseATK ?? attackStatSettings.baseATK,
    [Number(ensureCombatStats(character).atkPercent)]);
}
